mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.post_id, p.title AS post_title, pc.content, pc.created_at FROM post_comment pc JOIN post p ON p.id = pc.post_id WHERE pc.deleted = false AND p.deleted = false AND pc.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY pc.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (member_id, post_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{postId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted = false
UPDATE post SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted = false
